name: New Photo Gallery
author: A WP Life

sections.description:
Photo Gallery Starter helps you create beautiful image galleries for your website. Whether you want to showcase photos, build a portfolio, or display team members, this gallery solution handles it all with a clean, responsive design.

Free Demo | Premium Demo | Get Premium

What You Can Create

  • Photo Galleries – Display your images in organized grid layouts
  • Portfolio Galleries – Showcase your work with hover effects
  • Lightbox Galleries – Open images in a full-screen lightbox viewer
  • Video Galleries – Embed YouTube and Vimeo videos
  • Team Galleries – Present team members with photos and descriptions
  • Logo Galleries – Display client logos or brand partners

Key Features (Free Version)

  • Responsive grid layout that adapts to all screen sizes
  • Lightbox functionality with thumbnail navigation
  • Unlimited galleries with unlimited images
  • YouTube and Vimeo video support
  • Image titles and descriptions
  • Multiple column layouts (2, 3, 4, 5, 6 columns)
  • Hover effects on thumbnails
  • Shortcode support for pages and posts
  • Translation ready

Premium Features

Upgrade to the premium version for additional capabilities:

  • Masonry Gallery Layout – Pinterest-style dynamic grid
  • 30 Hover Effects – Variety of animation styles for thumbnails
  • Load More Button – Pagination with load more functionality
  • Map Gallery – Display images with location data
  • Link Gallery – Add custom links to gallery items
  • Fixed Size Lightbox – Consistent lightbox dimensions
  • 2D Transition Effects – Smooth animations between images
  • Shadow and Glow Effects – Visual enhancements for thumbnails
  • Lightbox Tool Color Picker – Customize lightbox interface colors
  • Background Color Events – Interactive color changes on hover
  • Custom CSS Support – Add your own styling
  • Priority Support – Fast response from our support team

View Premium Demo | Get Premium Version

How to Use

  1. Go to Photo Gallery > Add New in your dashboard
  2. Enter a title for your gallery
  3. Upload images using the media uploader
  4. Configure gallery settings (columns, spacing, hover effects)
  5. Copy the generated shortcode
  6. Paste the shortcode into any page or post
  7. View your page to see the gallery
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard
  2. Search for “Photo Gallery Starter”
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the zip file and click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin

After Activation

  1. Navigate to Photo Gallery in your admin menu
  2. Click Add New to create your first gallery
  3. Upload images and configure settings
  4. Use the shortcode in your pages or posts
sections.faq:
How do I create a photo gallery?

Go to Photo Gallery > Add New in your dashboard. Enter a title, upload your images, configure the display settings, and copy the shortcode. Paste this shortcode into any page or post to display your gallery.

Can I add multiple galleries to one page?

Yes, you can add as many galleries as you want to a single page. Simply paste multiple shortcodes in your page content, and each gallery will display separately.

Is the gallery responsive on mobile devices?

Yes, all galleries are fully responsive. The layout automatically adjusts based on screen size, so your galleries look great on desktops, tablets, and mobile phones.

How do I add videos to my gallery?

When adding items to your gallery, you can choose to add a YouTube or Vimeo video URL instead of an image. The plugin will automatically fetch the video thumbnail and embed the player in the lightbox.

Can I customize the lightbox appearance?

The free version includes standard lightbox styling with thumbnail navigation. The premium version offers additional customization options including color pickers for lightbox tools and custom CSS support.

What image formats are supported?

The plugin supports all standard web image formats including JPG, JPEG, PNG, GIF, and WebP.

How do I change the number of columns?

In the gallery settings, you will find a column layout option. You can choose from 2 to 6 columns depending on how you want your images to display.

Can I use the gallery in widget areas?

Yes, you can use the gallery shortcode in text widgets or any widget that supports shortcodes to display galleries in sidebars and other widget areas.

Does the plugin affect website loading speed?

The plugin is optimized for performance. Images are loaded efficiently, and the lightbox scripts only load when needed. For large galleries, consider using optimized images.

How do I get support for this plugin?

For free version support, please post your questions on the plugin support forum. Premium users receive priority support through our website.

Can I translate the plugin to my language?

Yes, the plugin is translation ready. You can use any translation plugin or create your own translation files to translate the interface to your language.

How do I display only specific images from my gallery?

Currently, the shortcode displays all images in a gallery. If you need to show different image sets, create separate galleries for each group of images.
